title: The Parable of the Friend at Midnight
description: Jesus tells a parable about a man who, in the middle of the night, asks a friend for three loaves of bread to serve an unexpected guest. The friend inside the house initially refuses to get up but eventually gives in because of the man's persistence. Jesus uses this story to teach his disciples about persistent prayer: ask, seek, knock – and the Father in heaven will give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him. [ref:Luk 11:5-13|Luke 11:5-13]
